page_title: ROM 2-4 INT | AS Roma v Inter 10/02/2024, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+6' There will be no more action in this match as the referee signals full time.
90+3' 2 - 4 Alessandro Bastoni (Inter) has acres of space after latching on to a precise pass into the box. He doesn't hesitate to unleash a great effort which ends up in the middle of the goal.
90+2' The referee shows a yellow card to Dean Huijsen (AS Roma). No wonder. A clear yellow for bad language.
90' 5 min. of stoppage-time to be played.
87' Daniele De Rossi has decided to make a change. Sardar Azmoun (AS Roma) replaces Paulo Dybala.
87' The referee signals that it is time for a substitution and Alexis Sanchez (Inter) will replace Marcus Thuram.
86' AS Roma failed to take advantage of the corner as the opposition's defence was alert and averted the threat.
84' Leonardo Spinazzola (AS Roma) sends a rebound goalwards towards the right-hand post, but the goalkeeper stretches to stop it.
84' The resulting set piece from AS Roma is comfortably intercepted by one of the defending players.
81' Half-chance! Rick Karsdorp (AS Roma) plays a pass into the box, but Yann Sommer reacts well to snuff out the attack.
79' AS Roma string together a series of short passes.
76' Here comes a substitution. Lorenzo Pellegrini is given a rest as he is replaced by Tommaso Baldanzi (AS Roma).
76' Substitution. Stephan El Shaarawy is replaced by Nicola Zalewski (AS Roma).
75' Here's the change. Lautaro Martinez leaves the pitch and Marko Arnautovic (Inter) comes on as a substitute.
75' Here is a change. Matteo Darmian is going off and Masssimiliano Farris gives the last tactical orders to Denzel Dumfries (Inter).
75' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Federico Dimarco departs the field of play to be replaced by Carlos Augusto (Inter).
73' Federico Dimarco (Inter) tries to find the head of a teammate in the box but overhits the cross.
71' Romelu Lukaku (AS Roma) connects with a cross from the side, but produces a header which goes miles wide of the right post.
67' Some neat passing and movement from Inter as they ping around some short passes in order to create a new attacking opportunity.
65' Corner kicks – 1:8.
63' That's the end of the game for Francesco Acerbi, who is replaced by Stefan de Vrij (Inter).
63' Paulo Dybala (AS Roma) sends a cross into the box, but Yann Sommer comes off his line to gather the ball.
61' Daniele De Rossi has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Leonardo Spinazzola (AS Roma) replacing Angelino.
61' The referee signals that it is time for a substitution and Edoardo Bove (AS Roma) comes onto the pitch so that Bryan Cristante can be given a rest.
59' Inter can’t profit from the corner as the defence clear the ball upfield.
59' Benjamin Pavard (Inter) takes a shot from outside the box and hits the left post!
56' 2 - 3 It's an own goal! A pitiful moment for Angelino (AS Roma), who tries to clear a cross into the six-yard box but instead sends the ball behind his own keeper. The score is 2:3.
55' Matteo Darmian (Inter) delivers a promising cross into the box, but it's cleared.
52' Total attempts – 5:7.
49' 2 - 2 Marcus Thuram (Inter) receives the ball inside the box, reacts quickly and without any problems stabs the ball inside the right post.

49' Hakan Calhanoglu (Inter) has the opportunity to threaten the opponent's goal via a free kick on the edge of the box. He hits a decent low strike towards the middle of the goal, but Rui Patricio denies him with a great save.
47' Gianluca Mancini (AS Roma) is booked after bringing down an opponent. Marco Guida had an easy-decision to make.
46' The game restarts for the second half.
45+5' Marco Guida has ended the first half by blowing the whistle.
45+4' There's a melee in the box, but the referee isn't interested in the appeals from Inter for a penalty. Play continues.
45+4' The ball goes out of play. Inter are awarded a corner kick.
45+3' An opponent rises to his feet after being downed by Matteo Darmian (Inter). Marco Guida saw the sliding tackle and blows for a foul.
45' The fourth official shows 3 min. of added time.
44' 2 - 1 Stephan El Shaarawy (AS Roma) gets on the scoresheet! He receives a killer pass and strikes the ball in off the left post.
44' A quickly taken corner by Inter.
42' That was close by Paulo Dybala (AS Roma)! He receives a pass on the edge of the box and shoots, but the ball goes by a whisker over the crossbar.
41' Federico Dimarco (Inter) finds himself in space on the edge of the box and tries to catch the keeper out, but the shot lacks accuracy and curls well wide of the right post.
38' Federico Dimarco (Inter) produces a poor lofted pass into the penalty box. His attempt is easily thwarted by the defence.

38' The game is interrupted. Gianluca Mancini (AS Roma) has violated the rules in the battle for the ball. No protests or gestures are being made as he is quite aware of what he did. Inter have a free kick.
35' The corner is swung in but Inter can’t take advantage as a defender sweeps the ball away.
34' Leandro Paredes (AS Roma) fails to find a teammate across the pitch with a long ball.
32' Inter take a short corner kick.
31' An attempted cross from Benjamin Pavard (Inter) is cleared.
28' 1 - 1 The ball from the free kick finds its way to Gianluca Mancini (AS Roma) who rises and scores with a thunderous header inside the left post. An incredible long-range header!
26' Dangerous play by Romelu Lukaku (AS Roma). Marco Guida blows his whistle for a foul.
24' 59:41 – this is the current ball possession ratio.
20' Marco Guida sticks with his original decision after the VAR review. No infringement and the goal stands!
19' The Inter players halt their celebrations as referee Marco Guida makes the VAR signal to review the goal, most likely to ascertain if there was an offside in the build-up play.
17' 0 - 1 Francesco Acerbi (Inter) is first to latch onto the rebound near the penalty spot, and he produces a fantastic header which goes inside the right post.
17' Inter will have a chance to score from a corner kick.
16' Federico Dimarco (Inter) takes the resulting corner which is well defended.

16' Nicolo Barella (Inter) collects a pass and finds himself in a good position to strike from the edge of the box, but his attempt is blocked. The referee and his assistant both point at the corner flag. Inter will have an opportunity to threaten the opposition's goal.
13' Inter take a short corner instead of sending the ball into the penalty area.
11' Inter keep the ball and are displaying some tiki-taka style passing at the moment.
7' AS Roma players are exchanging short passes with one another, waiting for the right moment to beat the opposition's defence.
2' A good clearance by a defender means the corner comes to nothing for AS Roma.
1' The first half has started.
AS Roma will kick-off.
Marco Guida was nominated as the referee for this game.
Show lineups We now know the starting lineups. You can find them in the match details of this match.
